description: AM273x + AWR2243 2-chip cascade DDM demo (firmware_dev awr2243_cascade_ddm): TLV point cloud over serial; config accepted once per power-up.

valid_tx_counts.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: DDMA; 1 and 5 give numBandsEmpty=-1 (mss_main.c:4032-4058, rfparserDDMA.c:463-473)

n_rx.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: 2 chips x 4 RX; 3-RX per chip rejected by the range DPU

max_slope_mhz_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: silicon freqSlopeConst +-5510 x 48.28 kHz/us (rl_sensor.h; SWRS223D)

tested_max_slope_mhz_us.source: tools/radar_viewer/cfggen.py @ b416f61 MAX_SLOPE: repo-tested value, not a hardware bound (docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md)

max_sample_rate_ksps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: silicon digOutSampleRate 2000..50000 ksps (rl_sensor.h; 20 MHz IF)

tested_sample_rates_ksps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: the rates in TI's shipped cascade cfgs (cfggen.py FS_TESTED_KSPS); max tested 10000

min_idle_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: no documented minimum found (field 0..524287 x 10 ns); 4 us is cfggen.py MIN_IDLE_US, TI cfgs use 4-5

max_loops.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: rlFrameCfg numLoops 1..255 in legacy frame mode (rl_sensor.h)

max_samples_silicon.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md table: ADC buffer 16 kB per chip = 1024 complex samples x 4 RX (rl_sensor.h numAdcSamples)

max_samples.source: tools/radar_viewer/cfggen.py @ b416f61: TI only tested 192 samples x 256 chirps ('Chirp design is limited to 192 adc samples, 256 chirps') (docs/research/gui_board_limits_cascade_multiprofile.md: not firmware-enforced)

max_chirps.source: docs/research/gui_cascade_chirp_limit_2026-10-07.md: Doppler FFT size N = validFFT(chirps per frame) sizes the 82 KiB DSS L2 heap (~N(2V+16Rx+8) B); 256 chirps bench-confirmed, 1024 bench-failed; applies to the full 6TX/8RX config (reduced-TX configs only warn)

channel_cfg_args.source: cascade_shortrange.cfg: channelCfg rx tx cascading rx2 tx2

mimo.note: chirps per loop must be a multiple of 8 (DDMA bands rule, gui-13); all 6 TX fire on every chirp
mimo.source: docs/research/gui_multichirp_tdm.md (c1ccf7a) section 3: DDMA parser ignores the chirp mask; TDM only as a compile-time variant not in the shipped build

AWR2243_CASCADE.flash_hint: ./fw flash cascade_ddm <cli port> (docs/firmware.md Commands: SOP 101, flash, SOP 001, power-cycle)
AWR2243_CASCADE.note: HYPOTHESIS: overridePlatformString AM273X (cascade mmw_cli.c:2228); mcuplus CLI source not on this host; the cascade takes a cfg once per power-up, so it is not queried until bench-checked (gui-33 Step 7)

notes: cfarFovCfg is not registered in the cascade DDM build, so no FOV filter is offered.
The cascade accepts a cfg once per power-up.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: CFAR type. The Doppler direction must be CFAR-OS (3); range may use 0-3. CFAR-OS ranks the K-th smallest cell instead of averaging.

fields.label: Window
fields.help: Noise cells on each side of the cell under test (one-sided).

fields.label: Guard cells
fields.help: Guard cells; must be 0 for the Doppler direction (CFAR-OS). The range limit is not readable from the repo.

fields.label: Cyclic
fields.help: Wrap the window around the FFT edge.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Detection threshold in dB (0-100; the CLI rejects more).

fields.label: Peak grouping
fields.help: Keep only the local maximum among neighbouring detections.

fields.label: OS K value
fields.help: K of the ordered-statistic CFAR (the K-th ranked noise cell sets the level). Valid range against the window is not documented in the repo.

fields.label: OS edge K scaling
fields.help: Scale K for edge samples in non-cyclic CFAR-OS.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Switch the direction's CFAR on. Doppler CFAR cannot be disabled (the board prints an error and ignores it).
